origin.text: 让明亮的吉他主旋律与笛声副句交替，途中经过小调与降号侧的和声桥段。吉他独奏段的中间八小节重新写成停留、短答、下行释放和上行抵达，回归时再添一条较低的笛声对旋律。最后的安静段落像明信片边缘留出的空白；收尾将吉他和低音的F延续，让伴奏与打击乐逐步退下。
draftNotes: Full first draft with a syncopated guitar theme, a contrasting flute refrain, a through-written minor/flat-side bridge, a fully notated guitar feature and a register-expanded return.
origin.basis: Documented score structure and revision decisions; no autobiographical claim.

changes: Recomposed the feature’s middle eight bars with held targets, shorter answers, a descending five-note release and a fresh ascent into its final phrase.
Wrote a sixteen-bar lower flute counter-theme under the returning guitar song, replacing one repeated voicing tone per bar.
Contracted the piano’s return voicings to two inner notes so the two melodic lines remain separately legible.
Rephrased the quiet margin’s first four flute bars with a delayed question, one long answer and a renewed small rise.
Shortened the guitar’s last notes before its two flute handovers to create intentional written breathing room.

Joined the final guitar and bass Fs across two bars, changed the last piano color from F6 to a quiet F triad, and removed selected farewell percussion subdivisions. Room and release overlap remain intentional.

finalNotes: Rephrased the quiet margin’s first four flute bars with a delayed question, one long answer and a renewed small rise.

tracks.title: 天台的慢舞

origin.text: 把neo-soul的松弛感放进缓慢三拍子：电钢琴先写长句，经过降号侧的回应，再交给独立写成的独奏与低音区吉他。修订让吉他保留开头G–Bb–D的身份，却拥有自己的十二小节答句；伴奏改为延迟的两音支撑，鼓点在吉他段和结尾逐层退下，留下最后一次缓慢转身。
draftNotes: Full v1: G-minor neo-soul waltz, twelve-bar theme and flat-side answer, sixteen separately written solo bars, a guitar landing and lower-register recasting, suspended bridge and rewritten return.
origin.basis: Documented score structure and revision decisions; no autobiographical claim.

changes: Wrote twelve new guitar measures that retain the opening G–Bb–D identity but broaden the answer and descend to a low G.
Changed the solo and guitar accompaniment into delayed two-note shells.
Rebuilt bass register and semitone approaches into each changing root.
Added a new D–F pickup after the dominant F# to lead back into G.
Thinned and softened the guitar-feature drums, then withdrew percussion before the closing tonic.
Held the final G, low tonic and sparse closing voicing, and shaped four-bar solo articulation.

finalNotes: Full v1: G-minor neo-soul waltz, twelve-bar theme and flat-side answer, sixteen separately written solo bars, a guitar landing and lower-register recasting, suspended bridge and rewritten return.

v2: rewrote the guitar recasting as an independent lower melody, opened both foreground features with delayed two-note shell responses, and rebuilt the bass register with semitone approaches to changing chord roots.

v3: new bridge pickup, quieter and sparser guitar-feature drums, graduated coda withdrawal, one held final G and low tonic instead of repeated attacks, and four-bar articulation in the written piano solo.
Final independent review: corrected seven bass fifths from E to Eb on Am7b5; retained all intentional approaches and form.

tracks.title: 零点后的海岸

origin.text: 以较低的霓虹主题沿海岸展开，先给出第二句和较宽的回答，再让键盘与高音区贝司各自获得一个段落。高处回归并非原旋律简单移调，而是把D–F开头扩展到A与C后再下降。修订撤去贝司独奏旁的琶音，收疏过门与尾段鼓点，最后将主旋律、贝司和铺底的主音接成长线。
draftNotes: Full v1: slow D-minor synthwave with a low neighbor-note theme, broader answer, keyboard breakdown, independent eight-bar bass feature, quiet flat-side bridge and a higher then descending return.
origin.basis: Documented score structure and revision decisions; no autobiographical claim.

changes: Wrote eight new high-return measures, expanding the original D–F opening to A and C before descending through the dominant.
Removed the arpeggio from the bass feature and replaced its dense pad with quiet low two-note shells.
Recomposed the keyboard breakdown ending as a descending answer and checked its release against the bass entrance.
Reduced transition/closing drum density and added occasional kick pickups in the higher return.
Joined the final lead/bass/pad tonic and removed the last glass pattern; shaped phrase endings independently.

finalNotes: Full v1: slow D-minor synthwave with a low neighbor-note theme, broader answer, keyboard breakdown, independent eight-bar bass feature, quiet flat-side bridge and a higher then descending return.
v2: replaced the octave-copy return with eight newly written high-register sentences; opened the written bass feature by removing the arpeggio and changing dense pads to quiet low two-note shells.

v3: rewrote the keyboard breakdown ending as a descending answer; cleared its direct release before the bass feature, thinned the night-bridge entrance, added occasional high-return kick pickups, withdrew closing percussion and joined the last D into held lead/bass/pad arrivals.
Final independent review: selectively shortened C#/Bb pad bodies at altered-dominant exits; common pad tones and reflected resonance remain. No melodic rewrite or renderer change.

tracks.title: 黎明的五扇窗

origin.text: 这首环境音乐沿一条连续的弧线发展：光线从狭窄处进入，逐渐打开窗户，在陌生的和声中心停留，然后向室内收拢。中段添入独立的十二个高声部音符，补足和声色彩，并撤去竞争的敲击。结尾把重复的B改成延长的B–G#–E手势，让反射的间距和时值各自收缩；只在必要的半音交接处让直接发音先退开，保留房间余韵。
draftNotes: Full v1: one continuous five-part ambient arch, unequal harmonic spans, cross-bar bell sentences and two complementary window patterns. The center moves from E-major space to C/G/D major colors; the return contracts rather than introducing a chorus or feature solo.
origin.basis: Documented score structure and revision decisions; no autobiographical claim.

changes: Revoiced center C/G pads to include their major thirds.
Wrote an independent twelve-event high counterline across the central span.
Removed competing late left-window attacks there.
Delayed D# until beat201.8, after the suspended E pad direct release ends201.66; room reflections may remain.
Replaced closing B repetitions with three sustained B–G#–E gestures.
Varied the spacing/duration of contracting upper reflections and independently softened final bell and newly entering support.

finalNotes: Full v1: one continuous five-part ambient arch, unequal harmonic spans, cross-bar bell sentences and two complementary window patterns. The center moves from E-major space to C/G/D major colors; the return contracts rather than introducing a chorus or feature solo.

v2: stated E and B major thirds in the center C/G chords, replaced regular upper reflections with one independent twelve-event counterline, and removed competing late left-window attacks across that central span.

v3: moved the D# resolution after the suspended pad direct tail, recomposed the last four bars of left-hand support as B–G#–E, varied the contracting reflections and softened final bell/cloud/floor entries independently.

tracks.title: 夏日桥下

origin.text: 明亮的液态DnB以两条较长的主旋律句子进入，经过键盘独奏、十六小节空地和渐进回升，再展开新的后半段独奏。第二轮三十二小节的贝司与底鼓、军鼓重新写过，先偏低音区切分，再引入八度移动；借小调色彩的半速桥段给后面的主题回归留出距离。结尾让鼓组分层退出，让低音主音和晚到的钟声延续。
draftNotes: Full v1: B-flat major liquid DnB with two separately written thirty-two-bar foreground spans, keys feature, a flat-side clearing and half-time bridge, final head and eight-bar coda.
origin.basis: Documented score structure and revision decisions; no autobiographical claim.

changes: Recomposed the complete second thirty-two-bar bass and kick/snare parts: a more syncopated low-register first half, octave movement in the solo half and new ghost-snare placements.
Tied all eight unchanged two-bar pad pairs through the half-time bridge.
Rewrote the last four head bars as a lower D–Bb–G / F–A–C answer before the coda.
Shortened the last busy bass body so its .12-second release clears the half-time bridge; removed fresh hat attacks in the preceding half-beat.
Added a quiet three-hit snare pickup from half-time into the last head.
Merged the final two low Bb attacks, ended coda hats/snare in layers, and softened late bell reflections.
Shaped lead phrase endings and final piano attacks separately from the rhythm section.

tracks.title: 微开的窗

sectionMap.label: Two melodic lines in one room

origin.text: 用钢琴下行二度的句子和窗边吉他构成安静的后摇，不以响亮高潮作为终点。小调下属和声把视角带进更暗的房间，回归后两条旋律共处：新写的十二小节低音区吉他对旋律采用延长音与错位进入，铺底让出一个声部。告别段改成稀疏的七个吉他手势，钢琴以C–Bb–Ab收束，鼓与低音慢慢停止重新起音。
draftNotes: Original v1: a slow piano/guitar post-rock narrative in A-flat, with two separately written twelve-bar sentences, a minor-subdominant bridge, a changed return, contrapuntal conversation and quiet twelve-bar coda; no programmed loud climax.
origin.basis: Documented score structure and revision decisions; no autobiographical claim.

changes: Composed a new 24-note, twelve-bar lower guitar counterline with held steps and displaced entries, replacing the short duet fills.
Replaced the eight-bar bridge guitar pattern with alternating two-attack spacing.
Reduced the duet pad bed from three to two voices, leaving a register for the lower guitar.
Recomposed all twelve returning drum bars as alternating downbeat/offbeat kick and late rim gestures, with sparse tom answers.
Replaced the final eight bars of guitar pulse with seven spaced gestures, ending with one quiet held A-flat.
Recomposed the last piano phrase as C–B-flat–A-flat and merged the final two low A-flat bass attacks.
Advanced and shortened the last right-guitar answer to leave direct-envelope breath; withdrew kick/rim and ended with one soft tom.
Composed a new Ab–F guitar reflection before the minor-subdominant bridge.

finalNotes: Original v1: a slow piano/guitar post-rock narrative in A-flat, with two separately written twelve-bar sentences, a minor-subdominant bridge, a changed return, contrapuntal conversation and quiet twelve-bar coda; no programmed loud climax.

V2: replaced incidental duet fills with a 12-bar lower guitar counterline; halved and displaced the minor-subdominant bridge guitar pulse; thinned duet pad harmony to inner dyads; composed a new quiet alternating drum articulation for the changed return.

V3: dissolved the final eight bars of regular guitar pulse into seven widely spaced gestures; rewrote the closing piano line as C–B-flat–A-flat; joined the final tonic bass; advanced/shortened the last counterline answer and wrote a staggered kick/rim/tom exit; added a two-note guitar reflection before the borrowed-minor bridge.
